info.name: Flexi-Rate Calculator - verified examples
info.description: Local billing examples with status, header and full-body assertions. No authentication required.

item.name: 01-valid-with-billing-cycle - Valid snapshot with an explicit billing cycle

request.description: 41 consecutive quarter-hour chunks = 10.25 hours. The first 10 hours are free; the last paid chunk is peak usage. Base $0.25 + surcharge $0.05 = $0.30.

exec: pm.test('Complete response matches the billing contract', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.deep.equal(expected));

originalRequest.description: 41 consecutive quarter-hour chunks = 10.25 hours. The first 10 hours are free; the last paid chunk is peak usage. Base $0.25 + surcharge $0.05 = $0.30.

item.name: 02-malformed-event-type - Array instead of integer: skip one event

request.description: The exact client example: duration_minutes is [15]. That event is skipped, the valid event remains, and X-Invalid-Event-Count is 1.

exec: pm.test('Complete response matches the billing contract', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.deep.equal(expected));

originalRequest.description: The exact client example: duration_minutes is [15]. That event is skipped, the valid event remains, and X-Invalid-Event-Count is 1.

item.name: 03-duplicate-users - Duplicate user IDs reject the request

request.description: Two users have user_id alice. This is a request-level error, unlike duplicate events; HTTP 400 and no invalid-event header.

exec: pm.test('Complete response matches the billing contract', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.deep.equal(expected));
pm.test('Rejected request has no invalid-event count', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.has('X-Invalid-Event-Count')).to.equal(false));

originalRequest.description: Two users have user_id alice. This is a request-level error, unlike duplicate events; HTTP 400 and no invalid-event header.

item.name: 04-without-billing-cycle - Omitted cycle uses the user's current month

request.description: billing_cycle is absent. 41 valid events use the generation month's dates and cost $0.30. The returned cycle uses the server clock. The Postman pre-request script refreshes event dates to the current UTC month automatically; standalone JSON/cURL files are dated snapshots and can be refreshed by rerunning the generator.

exec: body.events = Array.from({length: 41}, (_, index) => ({event_id: `alice-${index + 1}`, user_id: 'alice', timestamp: new Date(start + index * 15 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(), duration_minutes: 15}));
pm.test('Complete response matches the billing contract', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.deep.equal(expected));

originalRequest.description: billing_cycle is absent. 41 valid events use the generation month's dates and cost $0.30. The returned cycle uses the server clock. The Postman pre-request script refreshes event dates to the current UTC month automatically; standalone JSON/cURL files are dated snapshots and can be refreshed by rerunning the generator.

exec: pm.test('Complete response matches the billing contract', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.deep.equal(expected));

originalRequest.description: Skips duration 20, start time 10:07, an invalid date, a missing duration, and null. One valid 15-minute event remains; invalid count 5.

originalRequest.description: The first valid event wins. The repeated ID is skipped, so usage is 15 minutes rather than 30 minutes; invalid count 1.

item.name: 11-timezone-month-boundary - The same UTC instant belongs to different local months

request.description: 2026-09-30T21:00Z is October 1 in Sofia but September 30 in UTC. For billing_cycle 2026-10, only Sofia's event counts. The UTC user's valid out-of-month event does not increase the invalid count.

exec: pm.test('Complete response matches the billing contract', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.deep.equal(expected));

originalRequest.description: 2026-09-30T21:00Z is October 1 in Sofia but September 30 in UTC. For billing_cycle 2026-10, only Sofia's event counts. The UTC user's valid out-of-month event does not increase the invalid count.

item.name: 12-enterprise-tier-comparison - Enterprise grace counts toward the rate threshold

request.description: Each user has 100 hours from 400 chronological off-peak chunks. Regular: 90 eligible/paid hours at $1 = $90. Enterprise: 100 eligible hours selects $0.80, but only 90 paid hours = $72. The free allowance is per user. This is intentionally the larger request; import the collection to avoid copying its long cURL.

exec: pm.test('Complete response matches the billing contract', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.deep.equal(expected));

originalRequest.description: Each user has 100 hours from 400 chronological off-peak chunks. Regular: 90 eligible/paid hours at $1 = $90. item.name: 15-invalid-request-shape - The events container itself must be an array

request.description: An event may be malformed, but events itself must be an array. This request has an object instead and returns HTTP 400.

exec: const expected = {"code":"INVALID_REQUEST","message":"Provide valid JSON, users with IDs/enterprise flags/timezones, and an events array."};
pm.test('Complete response matches the billing contract', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.deep.equal(expected));
pm.test('Rejected request has no invalid-event count', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.has('X-Invalid-Event-Count')).to.equal(false));

response.name: Expected response

originalRequest.description: An event may be malformed, but events itself must be an array. This request has an object instead and returns HTTP 400.
